units: <cite ref="Taanit 20b:9">Taan. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מימי לא הִקְפַּדְתִּי וכ׳</he> never did I lose my temper in my house; Y. ib. III, end, 67ᵃ. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ (prayer on entering the schoolhouse) <he>שלא אַקְפִּיד … יַקְפִּידוּ וכ׳</he> that I may not get excited over my colleagues, and my colleagues may not get excited over me.
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:4">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>והלל לא יַקְפִּיד</he> and Hillel (I) shall not get impatient.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite> <he>מַקְפִּיד על דבריו</he>, v. <cite ref="M03079"><he>מָתַן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:2">Ex. R. s. 6</cite> <he>ואף הוא מקפיד</he> (not <he>מקפידו</he>) and he (Moses) also lost his temper.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ואתה מקפיד על דברי</he> and thou losest thy temper in spite of my word (that declared thee the most patient of men)?; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to provoke, insult. Y. Keth. IV, 28ᵈ bot. ה׳ את וכ׳ he insulted an elder and struck him.
to be strict, particular; to care for, mind.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:3">Mikv. IX, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:7">7</cite> <he>כל המקפיד עליו הוצץ</he> whatever one minds (on one’s body) causes a partition for immersion, v. <cite ref="H01533"><he>חָצַץ</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 75a:8">B. Mets. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>בני חבורה המַקְפִּידִין וכ׳</he> members of a party that are particular with one another (in lending and borrowing); <cite ref="Shabbat 149a">Sabb. 149ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 107b:20">Ḥull. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>שני אחין ומקפידין וכ׳</he> two brothers (taking separate meals at the same table) who are particular with each other.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:11">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>לא היתה מַקְפֶּדֶת וכ׳</he> did not mind the pollution through idolatry; a. v. fr.
